title: Engineering H2 External Evidence Acceptance Worksheet

worksheet_rows.required_action: fill the package manifest from the template with controlled provenance and exact file hashes
stage at least three real source CAD files for a tank/pipe large-layout campaign
stage at least three cleaned simulation geometries derived from the source CAD files
record units, watertightness, degeneracy, positive volume/area, and meter-space bounding boxes per geometry
provide a controlled data-room index with source/cleaned file roles, labels, relative paths, hashes, source type, revision, and owner/supplier
provide cleanup quality records for at least three geometries with true cleanup checks, bbox fields, tool/method, and reviewer
replace the metadata template with URL/DOI, source file hash, digitization method, uncertainty basis, and case-alignment booleans
digitize or obtain Gas01..Gas12 coordinates with reliability tags and <=0.02 m uncertainty
digitize or obtain baffles 1..4 bounds with source basis and <=0.02 m uncertainty
obtain original Excel or digitize Gas01..Gas12 concentration histories through at least 120 s
select calibration sources and record source hash, uncertainty, and all case-alignment booleans
digitize or obtain heat-flux measurements with distances, tolerances, and source basis
digitize or obtain peak overpressure measurements with distances, tolerances, and source basis
rerun the official fire consequence report with the generated calibration dataset JSON
